items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: we did 2 things that Kay Starr had smashes of.

ctx.x: Because it could be told later on, okay. Well, during that record band, that's where 2 of Kay Starr's hits were made, during the record band, and Capital was right next to Wallachs, and they had the offices upstairs, and they set up a recording thing in the President's office. They set up the whole recording thing, and we used to go up there, and we did 2 things that Kay Starr had smashes of.
